metadata.title: Full LRS Architecture Explorer
metadata.note: Edit the status fields here when the repository status changes; the diagram reads everything from this file.

planes.label: Ingestion
planes.hint: Ingestion accepts statements and puts them on a durable queue.

planes.label: Processing
planes.hint: Processing validates, enriches and pseudonymizes statements, and runs the compression that produces summaries.

planes.label: Storage
planes.hint: Storage holds the log, the graph and the identity vault.

planes.label: Analytics
planes.hint: Analytics runs the queries behind every report.

planes.label: Presentation
planes.hint: Presentation renders dashboards and admin screens.

built.label: Built
built.meaning: code exists in the companion repository and has been run

partial.label: Files exist
partial.meaning: infrastructure and schema files exist, but the workers that feed them do not

designed.label: Designed
designed.meaning: in the design document, no code yet

context.label: Outside the LRS
context.meaning: system context, not an LRS component

nodes.label:
Textbooks
(MicroSims)
nodes.role: Intelligent textbooks whose MicroSims and pages produce xAPI statements; they sit outside the LRS.
dependencies: A bearer token that maps to the district
nodes.statusNote: Emitters that POST statements to the gateway are not built: the Chapter 17 runtime has a transport seam and no network call.

nodes.label: Gateway
nodes.role: The HTTP front door: authenticates the token, validates each statement against the producer contract, assigns ids and stored_at, queues the batch, and replies only after the queue acknowledges.
dependencies: The event stream (its only hard dependency; it may not import a ClickHouse, Neo4j or Redis client)
nodes.statusNote: Built, verified against a live Redpanda, with 28 contract tests reported.

nodes.label:
Event stream
(Redpanda / Kafka)
nodes.role: An ordered, durable log of statements, keyed by district and learner so each learner's statements keep their order; slow consumers can catch up or replay.
dependencies: A Kafka-protocol broker: Redpanda in development, Kafka in production
nodes.statusNote: Topic bootstrap built as files; the development bootstrap creates the raw topic with 6 partitions instead of the design's 48. No processor consumes it yet.

nodes.label: Identity service
nodes.role: The only component allowed to reach the vault; it gives the processor each district's salt so the learner's identity becomes an opaque student_key (HMAC-SHA256).
nodes.statusNote: Designed, not built. Until it exists, the processor must not invent a salt.

nodes.label: Processors
nodes.role: Workers that read the raw topic in batches, pseudonymize the actor, resolve activities, enrich, update mastery, write one insert to ClickHouse, then commit the offset.
nodes.statusNote: Designed, not built; the TODO file calls it the critical path.

nodes.label: Summarizer
nodes.role: Reads changed summary rows from ClickHouse about every 60 seconds and writes absolute values to Neo4j summary vertices: recompute absolutes, never increment.

nodes.label: Reconciler
nodes.role: Matches never-before-seen textbooks and activities, recorded as provisional stubs, to published metadata in the graph.
dependencies: Reconcile tasks from the processors (lrs.reconcile topic)

nodes.label:
Vault
(PostgreSQL)
nodes.role: A separate PostgreSQL instance holding real roster identities, their keys and the per-district salts.
dependencies: None inside the LRS; only the identity service may reach it

nodes.label:
ClickHouse
(statement log)
nodes.role: The system of record: every statement at full fidelity, ordered by district, learner and time, partitioned by month and deduplicated by statement id.
dependencies: The processor that writes to it
nodes.statusNote: DDL files built; applying them is manual. When last inspected the statement table held zero rows.

nodes.label:
Neo4j
(graph)
nodes.role: Holds structure (tenancy tree, textbook contents, concept prerequisites) and compact summary vertices, one per grain; it has no statement vertices.
dependencies: The summarizer and the reconciler that write to it
nodes.statusNote: Constraint file built and applied by hand; a demo seeder writes summary vertices marked seeded.

nodes.label: Analytics API
nodes.role: Runs the queries behind every report: aggregates from the ClickHouse log, summaries and structure from the Neo4j graph, with role-based access.

nodes.label: Dashboards
nodes.role: Dashboards and admin screens for instructors, administrators and authors.
nodes.statusNote: Prototype Dash apps run over a seeded graph with synthetic data; production dashboards are designed, not built.

edges.carries: xAPI statements in an HTTPS POST to /xapi/statements with a district bearer token (no emitter sends them yet)
Validated statements with ids and stored_at, keyed district:learner; the gateway replies after the queue acknowledges
Raw statements, read in order per partition, in batches of up to 1,000 or 200 ms
The district's salt, used to derive the pseudonymous student_key
Roster identities, keys and per-district salts (only the identity service may read the vault)
Pseudonymized, enriched statements, one insert per batch; the offset is committed after the write
Changed summary rows from the rollups, about every 60 seconds
Absolute summary values (MERGE ... SET, never +=), one vertex per grain
Reconcile tasks for unknown textbooks and activities (lrs.reconcile topic)
Matched metadata that resolves provisional stubs
Aggregate queries over the statement log
Summary vertices and structure (tenancy, concepts, prerequisites)
Report data for instructors, administrators and authors
